fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SE corner of the property - the entry driveway funnels through a checkpoint with gate arms/fencing across the truck lane (visible in zoom-20 satellite).
fieldNotes.guardShack: A distinct guard-booth structure sits in the middle of the entry driveway (zoom-19/20 satellite at ~35.4507,-119.1972), with a tractor-trailer stopped beside it being processed - clear staffed booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large white-roofed warehouse (~420 m long, solar panels on roof) with continuous dock-door banks and trailers backed in on BOTH the west and east long faces - well into the 50+ band (1,063,337 sq ft per Racklify).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two separate building faces (east and west).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large trailer drop yard along the east side of the building with 100+ parked trailers.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide concrete entrance apron / truck court at the gate provides ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Wonderful Industrial Park area on the edge of Shafter, CA - surrounded by bare lots and farmland; rural setting despite the industrial cluster.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared entry/exit driveway through the guard booth; lane split not resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; left in uncertainFields.
